behavior.canary: fs:0x28 saved at rsp+0x18, checked before return, __stack_chk_fail on mismatch
behavior.dest_empty: header is reset (root 0, extremes = container + 0x8, count 0), pool head 0, then the source tree is deep-copied if its root is non-null
behavior.general: deep-copy the source tree, reset the header (root, leftmost via the +0x10 spine, rightmost via the +0x18 spine, count from source +0x28), then destroy leftover old nodes via the teardown loop while (rsp) is non-null
behavior.landing_pad: 0x514c8da: endbr64, move rax to rbx, jump to the shared cleanup at 0x514c74e, which erases the node in (rsp), checks the canary and calls _Unwind_Resume
behavior.self_assign: rdi == rsi returns immediately; nothing is copied, allocated or destroyed
behavior.src_empty: header is reset the same way and the whole old tree is destroyed by the teardown loop
